  ENTITY: TargetR - Status
  EVENT: Scheduled

  OUTPUT: SYS.Query.SET.Screens

    TARGET: SYS.Iteration.ID

        DATA.Inventory.MAC address == SYS.Iteration.Screen.id
        OR DATA.Inventory.TargetR - MAC address == SYS.Iteration.Screen.id

      TYPE: CREATE
      ENTITY: TargetR - Status

Inventory|Create subscription.Description - MD:
# Create subscription

TRIGGER:
  ENTITY: Inventory
  EVENT: Change
  ID: CTX.Trigger.ID
  CONDITION:
    REF.Inventory.Subscription contract - Add new IS NOT EMPTY

QUERY 1:
  ENTITY: Subscription contracts
  WHERE:
    REF.Subscription contracts.Inventory - Subscription contract - Add new CONTAINS CTX.Trigger.ID
  OUTPUT: SYS.Query.SET.ExistingContracts

QUERY 2:
  ENTITY: Subscriptions
  WHERE:
    REF.Subscriptions.Subscription contract == REF.CTX.Trigger.Subscription contract - Add new
    AND DATA.Subscriptions.ID CONTAINS CTX.Trigger.ID
  OUTPUT: SYS.Query.SET.ExistingSubscriptions

ACTION GROUP 1:
  IF:
    SYS.Query.SET.ExistingContracts.ListOfStartDate IS EMPTY
  THEN:
    TYPE: NOTIFY
    CHANNEL: Slack

ACTION GROUP 2:
  ELSE IF:
    SYS.Query.SET.ExistingContracts.ListOfStartDate IS NOT EMPTY
    AND DATA.CTX.Trigger.Player == "Yes"
    AND COUNT(SYS.Query.SET.ExistingSubscriptions) == 0
    AND REF.CTX.Trigger.Subscription contract - Add new IS NOT EMPTY
    AND STATE.CTX.Trigger.Spare == FALSE
  THEN:

    ACTION 2.1:
      TYPE: CREATE
      ENTITY: Subscriptions
      SET:
        REF.Subscriptions.Inventory = CTX.Trigger.ID
        DATA.Subscriptions.Start date = SYS.Query.SET.ExistingContracts.ListOfStartDate
        REF.Subscriptions.Subscription contract = REF.CTX.Trigger.Subscription contract - Add new

    ACTION 2.2:
      TYPE: UPDATE
      ENTITY: Inventory
      TARGET: CTX.Trigger.ID
      SET:
        REF.Inventory.Subscription contract = REF.CTX.Trigger.Subscription contract - Add new + REF.CTX.Trigger.Subscription contract
        REF.Inventory.Subscription contract - Add new = EMPTY

ACTION GROUP 3:
  ELSE:
    TYPE: UPDATE
    ENTITY: Inventory
    TARGET: CTX.Trigger.ID
    SET:
      REF.Inventory.Subscription contract - Add new = EMPTY
---
Critical mechanics
- `Subscription contract - Add new` acts as a temporary staging link, not as durable state.
- Subscription creation is restricted to non-spare inventory explicitly marked as player inventory.
- Existing subscription detection prevents duplicate subscription creation for the same inventory/contract pairing, but the current implementation relies on ID-pattern logic rather than pure relational matching.
- The staging link is cleared in both success and failure branches, making the process self-resetting but also destructive for troubleshooting.
Inventory|Create subscription.Side Effects: Staging link Subscription contract - Add new is destructively cleared in all branches, including failure
Inventory|Create subscription.Description: Fires when Inventory record's Subscription contract - Add new staging field is populated. Validates contract has a start date, checks inventory is a non-spare player device with no existing subscription, creates the Subscription record, moves the contract link to the permanent field, and clears the staging link in all branches.

# Copy subscription contract

TRIGGER:
  ENTITY: Subscription contracts
  EVENT: Change
  ID: CTX.Trigger.ID
  SOURCE:
    UI.Interface = "Contract detail pane"
    UI.Action = "Button sets Trigger - Renew contract = TRUE"
  CONDITION:
    STATE.Subscription contracts.Trigger - Renew contract == TRUE

ACTION 1:
  TYPE: SCRIPT
  ENTITY: Subscription contracts
  TARGET: CTX.Trigger.ID
  OUTPUT: SYS.Script.newDate
  LOGIC:
    - Read End date from triggering record
    - Add 1 day
    - Format as YYYY-MM-DD
    - Output SYS.Script.newDate

ACTION 2:
  TYPE: CREATE
  ENTITY: Subscription contracts
  OUTPUT: SYS.Create.ID.NewContract
  SET:
    REF.Subscription contracts.Customer = REF.CTX.Trigger.Customer
    DATA.Subscription contracts.Service = DATA.CTX.Trigger.Service
    REF.Subscription contracts.Subscription type = REF.CTX.Trigger.Subscription type
    DATA.Subscription contracts.Bill type = DATA.CTX.Trigger.Bill type
    DATA.Subscription contracts.Payment method = DATA.CTX.Trigger.Payment method
    DATA.Subscription contracts.Invoice frequency = DATA.CTX.Trigger.Invoice frequency
    DATA.Subscription contracts.PPU/month = DATA.CTX.Trigger.PPU/month
    DATA.Subscription contracts.PPL/month = DATA.CTX.Trigger.PPL/month
    DATA.Subscription contracts.Currency = DATA.CTX.Trigger.Currency
    DATA.Subscription contracts.Start date = SYS.Script.newDate
    REF.Subscription contracts.Linked contracts = CTX.Trigger.ID
    REF.Subscription contracts.Sales = REF.CTX.Trigger.Sales

ACTION 3:
  TYPE: UPDATE
  ENTITY: Subscription contracts
  TARGET: CTX.Trigger.ID
  SET:
    REF.Subscription contracts.Linked contracts = SYS.Create.ID.NewContract
    STATE.Subscription contracts.Trigger - Renew contract = FALSE

QUERY 1:
  ENTITY: Inventory
  WHERE:
    REF.Inventory.Subscription contract CONTAINS CTX.Trigger.ID
    AND STATE.Inventory.Subscription - Status != "Terminated"
  OUTPUT: SYS.Query.SET.ActiveInventoryOnOldContract

ACTION 4:
  TYPE: ITERATE
  OVER: SYS.Query.SET.ActiveInventoryOnOldContract
  DO:
    TYPE: UPDATE
    ENTITY: Inventory
    TARGET: SYS.Iteration.ID
    SET:
      REF.Inventory.Subscription contract - Add new = SYS.Create.ID.NewContract

SIDE EFFECT:
  ACTION 4 triggers automation:
    "Create subscription record"

Critical mechanics
- Renewal is initiated only by explicit trigger flag on the source contract.
- Successor contract start date is derived as source End date + 1 day.
- Only non-terminated inventory linked to the source contract is rolled forward.
- Inventory reassignment does not directly create subscriptions; it triggers downstream automation through `Subscription contract - Add new`.
- Renewal completeness depends on every commercially relevant field being copied during contract creation.
Inventory|Copy subscription contract.Side Effects: Triggers Create subscription record on all non-terminated inventory via staging link write; re-trigger creates a duplicate successor contract
Inventory|Copy subscription contract.Description: Fires when Trigger - Renew contract flag is set on a Subscription Contract. Calculates successor start date (end date + 1 day), creates a new contract copying all commercial fields, links both contracts bidirectionally, then stages the new contract on all non-terminated inventory linked to the original (triggering downstream subscription creation).

Data|DEV - Hydrate HS Quotes.Description - MD:
# DEV - Hydrate HS Quotes

TRIGGER:
  ENTITY: HS - Quotes
  EVENT: Change
  ID: CTX.Trigger.ID
  WHERE:
    STATE.Trigger == TRUE

ACTION 1:
  TYPE: SCRIPT
  ENTITY: HS - Quotes
  TARGET: CTX.Trigger.ID
  INPUT:
    META.Quote.ID = REF.HS - Quotes.Quote ID
    META.Record.ID = CTX.Trigger.ID
    META.Secret.Token = SYS.Secret.HS - Quote - Hydrate
  DO:
    STEP 1: DELETE all Quote - Line Items WHERE REF.Quote - Line Items.HS - Quotes == CTX.Trigger.ID
    STEP 2: FETCH Quote from HubSpot using META.Quote.ID
    STEP 3: RESOLVE associated Deal, Contact, Company, and Line Item IDs from fetched Quote
    STEP 4: IF Deal exists, FETCH Deal and derive:
      - META.Deal.Name
      - META.Deal.Service
      - fallback Contact ID
      - fallback Company ID
    STEP 5: IF Contact exists, FETCH Contact and derive:
      - META.Contact.Name
      - META.Contact.Email
    STEP 6: IF Company exists, FETCH Company and derive:
      - META.Company.Name
      - META.Company.Address
      - META.Company.City
      - META.Company.Zip
      - META.Company.Country
    STEP 7: IF Quote Owner exists, FETCH Owner and derive:
      - META.Owner.Name
      - META.Owner.Email
    STEP 8: UPDATE HS - Quotes TARGET CTX.Trigger.ID SET:
      STATE.Status = META.Quote.hs_status
      DATA.Currency = META.Quote.hs_currency
      DATA.PublicQuoteURL = META.Quote.hs_quote_link
      DATA.DealName = META.Deal.Name
      DATA.Service = META.Deal.Service
      DATA.CustomerName = META.Contact.Name
      DATA.CustomerEmail = META.Contact.Email
      DATA.CompanyName = META.Company.Name
      DATA.BillingStreet = META.Company.Address
      DATA.BillingCity = META.Company.City
      DATA.BillingZipCode = META.Company.Zip
      DATA.BillingCountry = META.Company.Country
      DATA.ContractStartDate = META.Quote.hs_contract_effective_start_date
      DATA.TemplateType = META.Quote.hs_template_type
      DATA.QuoteNumber = META.Quote.hs_quote_number
      DATA.QuoteTitle = META.Quote.hs_title
      DATA.TermsAndConditions = META.Quote.hs_terms
      REF.QuoteOwner.ID = META.Quote.hubspot_owner_id
      DATA.QuoteOwnerName = META.Owner.Name
      DATA.QuoteOwnerEmail = META.Owner.Email
    STEP 9: ITERATE over associated Line Items
      FOR EACH SYS.Iteration.LineItemID:
        FETCH HubSpot Line Item
        IF properties exist:
          CREATE Quote - Line Items SET:
            DATA.ItemName = META.LineItem.name
            DATA.SKU = META.LineItem.hs_sku
            DATA.Quantity = NUM(META.LineItem.quantity)
            DATA.UnitPrice = NUM(META.LineItem.price)
            DATA.TermTotal = NUM(META.LineItem.amount)
            REF.HS - Quotes = CTX.Trigger.ID
            DATA.Tax = NUM(META.LineItem.tax)
            DATA.DurationFoC = META.LineItem.foc_duration
            DATA.Duration = META.LineItem.duration
            DATA.BillingStartDate = META.LineItem.hs_recurring_billing_start_date
            DATA.BillingFrequency = META.LineItem.recurringbillingfrequency
            DATA.RecurringBillingTerms = META.LineItem.hs_recurring_billing_terms
            DATA.NumberOfPayments = META.LineItem.hs_recurring_billing_number_of_payments

ACTION 2:
  TYPE: UPDATE
  ENTITY: HS - Quotes
  TARGET: CTX.Trigger.ID
  SET:
    STATE.sys_line_items_created = TRUE
Data|DEV - Hydrate HS Quotes.Description: Fires when Trigger flag is set on an HS - Quotes record. Script fetches full quote data from HubSpot API (deal, contact, company, owner, line items), deletes existing Quote - Line Items, updates the HS - Quotes record with all fetched fields, and recreates line item records.

Inventory|Scan - Process input.Description - MD:
# Scan - Process input

TRIGGER:
  ENTITY: Scan - Input
  EVENT: Manual
  ID: CTX.Trigger.ID
  SOURCE:
    - UI.Interface: Scan - Input
      UI.Button: Process scans
    - UI.Interface: Admin/Scan
      UI.Button: Process

ACTION 1:
  TYPE: SCRIPT
  ENTITY: Scan - Input
  TARGET: CTX.Trigger.ID
  INPUT:
    CTX.Trigger.Field.Scan
  OUTPUT:
    SYS.Script.SET.SnNormalised
  LOGIC:
    - Read input value from field: Scan
    - Convert value to string
    - Trim leading and trailing whitespace
    - Split by line breaks
    - Trim each line item
    - Remove empty items
    - Return normalized list as SYS.Script.SET.SnNormalised

ACTION 2:
  TYPE: UPDATE
  ENTITY: Scan - Input
  TARGET: CTX.Trigger.ID
  SET:
    STATE.Scan = EMPTY

ACTION 3:
  TYPE: ITERATE
  OVER: SYS.Script.SET.SnNormalised
  DO:

    QUERY 1:
      ENTITY: Inventory
      WHERE:
        STATE.SN == SYS.Iteration.Value
        OR STATE.MACAddress == SYS.Iteration.Value
        OR STATE.InternalID == SYS.Iteration.Value
      OUTPUT: SYS.Query.SET.InventoryMatch

    ACTION 3.1:
      TYPE: CREATE
      ENTITY: Scan - Line items
      SET:
        STATE.ScannedBy = CTX.Trigger.User.Email
        STATE.Type = "Action"
        REF.ScanInput = CTX.Trigger.ID
        REF.Inventory = SYS.Query.SET.InventoryMatch
        STATE.Scan = SYS.Iteration.Value

----

Execution scope
- One manual trigger processes one Scan - Input record.
- The script converts the Scan field into a runtime set of non-empty line items.
- The Scan field is cleared immediately after extraction.
- Each extracted value is processed independently.
- Each value is matched against Inventory using three identifiers:
  - SN
  - MAC address
  - ID - Internal
- One Scan - Line items record is created per processed value.

---

Deterministic effect
- Input scan batch is consumed from Scan - Input.
- Source input is reset to empty after extraction.
- Processing output is persisted as atomic scan log rows in Scan - Line items.
- Inventory linkage depends entirely on query match result for the current iteration value.
Inventory|Scan - Process input.Side Effects: Scan field destructively cleared immediately after script extraction — input is not recoverable post-trigger
Inventory|Scan - Process input.Description: Button-triggered. Reads the Scan field from a Scan - Input record, normalizes and splits into individual values, clears the Scan field, then for each value queries Inventory by SN/MAC/Internal ID and creates a Scan - Line items record.

Inventory|Import inventory.Description - MD:
# Inventory import

TRIGGER:
  ENTITY: Inventory.Import inventory
  EVENT: Change
  ID: CTX.Trigger.ID
  CONDITION:
    CONTROL.FLAG.ImportInventory == TRUE

QUERY:
  ENTITY: Inventory.Inventory
  WHERE:
    DERIVED.REF.SN_NORMALISED == CTX.Trigger.FIELD.SN - Normalised
  OUTPUT: SYS.Query.SET.InventoryMatches

ACTIONS:

ACTION 1:
  TYPE: CONDITIONAL
  WHEN:
    SYS.Query.SET.InventoryMatches.LENGTH == 0
  DO:

    ACTION 1.1:
      TYPE: CREATE
      ENTITY: Inventory.Inventory
      TARGET: NEW
      SET:
        DATA.REF.SN.Primary = CTX.Trigger.FIELD.SN
        REF.RESOURCE.Primary = CTX.Trigger.FIELD.Device Model
        REF.LOCATION.INSTALLATION = CTX.Trigger.FIELD.Location - Installation
        DATA.TEXT.INSTALLATION_AREA = CTX.Trigger.FIELD.Installation area
        REF.IMPORT.Primary = CTX.Trigger.ID
        STATE.STATUS.Primary = CTX.Trigger.FIELD.Status
        META.USER.IMPORTED_BY = CTX.Trigger.FIELD.Created By.RecordID
        CONTROL.FLAG.Log = TRUE
        REF.BRAND.PREASSIGNED = CTX.Trigger.FIELD.Brand - Pre-assigned

    ACTION 1.2:
      TYPE: UPDATE
      ENTITY: Inventory.Import inventory
      TARGET: CTX.Trigger.ID
      SET:
        STATE.FLAG.IMPORTED = TRUE
        CONTROL.FLAG.ImportInventory = FALSE

ACTION 2:
  TYPE: CONDITIONAL
  WHEN:
    SYS.Query.SET.InventoryMatches.LENGTH > 0
  DO:

    ACTION 2.1:
      TYPE: UPDATE
      ENTITY: Inventory.Import inventory
      TARGET: CTX.Trigger.ID
      SET:
        STATE.FLAG.DUPLICATE = TRUE

    ACTION 2.2:
      TYPE: NOTIFY
      ENTITY: Slack.User
      TARGET: CTX.Trigger.FIELD.User who took action.Email
      SET:
        META.MESSAGE = "SN  is already available in Inventory and has not been imported."
Inventory|Import inventory.Side Effects: Slack DM to triggering user on duplicate detection
Inventory|Import inventory.Description: Fires when ImportInventory flag is set on an Import inventory record. Checks for duplicate SN in Inventory. If no match: creates Inventory record and marks import as IMPORTED. If duplicate found: marks as DUPLICATE and sends Slack DM to the triggering user.
